title: 第10章  长子降生杀人夜，李长生的血性
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
“好。”
“举高高咯。”
李长生慈爱地笑了笑，双手托住闺女腋下，往上一抛。
“咯咯咯……”
宁宁笑声在小院里回荡。
很天真活泼。
有点治愈。
李长生接住，再抛起，再接住，如此循环。
父女互动很温馨。
“爹爹，我还要飞飞……”
宁宁奶声奶气，小手抓着李长生的白胡子，笑得天真烂漫。
“好。”
“爹爹有点累了。”
“最后一次了哦。”
宁宁点点头：“好啊。最后一次。如果累坏了爹爹，我会心疼的。”
哈哈……
看来这小棉袄是贴心的。
不是漏风的哈。
李长生笑着又举了一次，就将女儿抱在怀里，用满是褶皱的脸颊蹭了蹭嫩滑的小脸。
“爹爹……”

“你胡子扎我脸了。”
宁宁伸出手，抓住李长生的胡子，拽了拽。
李长生一阵吃痛。
这丫头报复性那么强吗？
李长生吐槽一声，但是也没说什么。
这是自己的闺女啊。
这时江翠萍扶着腰，顶着鼓鼓的大肚子，挪到门口，看着温馨的一幕，满是柔情。
“你啊。”
“就惯着她。”
“都快被你宠上天了。”
李长生理直气壮。
“女娃娃嘛，就是要宠着的。”
江翠萍：“……”
真是一个女儿奴。
这时李长生淡淡的声音又传过来了。
“今天感觉怎么样？有没有下坠感？”
江翠萍摇摇头，眉头微蹙：
“感觉还行。”
“只要孩子不踢我，就不痛。”
“只是有时候莫名心慌得厉害。”

“跟生宁宁的时候差不多。”
李长生笑了笑：“应该快要生了。平时多注意一点。”
江翠萍满眼都是李长生：“嗯。”
随后好像想到了什么，又开口：
“夫君，我听隔壁赵大娘说，昨晚又消失了两户人家。”
李长生扶着其坐下，温柔地开口：
“别听那些长舌妇乱嚼舌根。”
“有我在天塌不下来。”
“你现在的任务，就是吃好睡好，把咱们老二平平安安生下来。”
“其他的，都别想。”
看着丈夫那镇定自若的眼神，江翠萍慌乱的心奇异地安定下来。
夫君可是很厉害的。
就像是一座山。
只要他在。
这个家就是安全的。
我在担心什么呢？
夜深人静。
妻女都睡熟。
李长生盘膝客厅的正中央，静静地修炼，像是蛰伏的老龟。
膝盖上横放着玄霜剑。

自从谢剑开启大阵。
他就剑不离身了。
日日如此。
夜夜如此。
现在已过去了七天。
这七天里安置区的人口每天都在减少。
【魔修作乱】？
在一个仙门脚下，这么久了，都抓不到魔修，也没有任何解释。
只布下了阵法将所有人都困住了。
到底是魔修作乱？
还是你们就是魔修啊？
某一天夜晚。
李长生灵识看到两位被阴影遮住脸的人，从巷子中经过。
第二天就有一位女修失踪了。
连尸体都没有的那种。
若是李长生猜得不错的话，这不是简单的杀人越货，而是某种邪修手段。
类似于合欢宗的采补。
用修士的精血和魂魄，来祭炼魔道法宝，或者冲击境界。
在青云宗脚下发生这种事。
青云宗……

真的烂透了。
李长生无奈叹了一口气。
之所以还能安稳到现在，全靠平日的伪装。
不惹事。
不暴露修为。
不沾染因果。
不出风头。
在魔修眼中，李长生就是低价值目标。
自然不会引起他们的注意。
但是只要这件事没有解决。
屠刀迟早会落到自己头上的。
李长生心头始终有一种紧迫感。
“啊。”
突然一阵惨叫划破了夜空。
声音源很近。
应该是隔壁赵大娘家。
赵大娘家庭是一个很老实的家庭。
李长生闻言，睁开眼，双眸精光暴涨。
紧接着。
嘈杂声传来，男人求饶声，女人哭喊声，以及利刃入肉的闷响。

声音戛然而止。
李长生纹丝不动。
他没有去救。
不是不想。
而是不能。
在这个黑吃黑的修仙界，那一丝廉价的同情心，早就被六十年的风霜磨灭了。
他身后有即将临盆的妻子。
有刚满周岁的女儿。
他赌不起。
只要那些人没有不开眼闯进他的院子。
他的可以装聋。
他也可以装瞎。
但是若有人敢迈入一步……
想到这里，李长生眼中杀机一闪，握剑的手微微下压。
若有人敢走进一步，就是不死不休。
两道黑影从墙头掠过，并未在李长生的院子停留，而是向着下一家奔去。
“晦气，这老太婆只有几块碎灵石。”
“那个老头也没多少气血，干瘪得像柴火。”
“走吧，去下一家。听说前面那户有个年轻的女修……”
声音渐行渐远。

李长生缓缓松开握剑柄的手，掌心已是冷汗。
哪怕他已经是练气九层巅峰。
但在这种大环境下，面对毫无底线的屠杀时，依旧感到无力。
弱小就是原罪。
“夫君，刚刚是什么声音？”
卧室里传来江翠萍颤抖的声音。
“没事，咱们睡觉吧。”
李长生收起剑，脸色温和，走进卧室。坐在床边，轻轻拍着妻子的后背，将一丝精纯的灵力渡入其体内，安抚胎气。
“夫君，我怕……”
“我好像听到了尖叫声……”
“那是你的错觉。”李长生柔声哄道。
“唔……”
江翠萍忽然闷哼一声，五官痛苦地皱在一起。
双手下意识地捂住高耸的腹部。
“痛……”
“夫君，肚子好痛……”
李长生闻言，脸色微变。
神识一扫。
羊水破了。
老二提前到来了？

为什么偏偏是这个时候生啊？
外面群狼环伺，血腥漫天。
屋内即将临盆，生死一线。
难道这就是天道对我的考验吗？
“别怕。”
“生就生。”
“还有我在呢。”
“跟着我的节奏。呼……吸……对，就这样。”
李长生强迫自己冷静下来。
上次生孩子的时候，还能去找稳婆。
这次没有稳婆。
没有稳婆。
我就是稳婆。
李长生目光坚定，这一年来他也看了不少医书，生产步骤早就烂熟于胸，就是没有实践过罢了。好在在修仙界，生孩子也不是什么危险的事情，就是要受罪一点。
李长生迅速从储物戒指中，取出提前准备好的产褥、热水符、止血丹、回气散。
“啊。”
“痛。”
江翠萍满头大汗，痛得浑身颤抖。
“呼气。”
“吸气。”

李长生新手稳婆，第一次开车上路，就对着自己的老婆摸着石头过河。
李长生是修仙者，对接生，有天然的优势。
一边用灵力护住江翠萍。
一边引导着胎位。
“哇。”
旁边的小床上的宁宁，也被这动静吵醒，哇哇地大哭。
屋内哭声、喊痛声交织。
屋外阴风怒号，杀机四伏。
“宁宁乖，不哭。”
李长生分出一缕神识，操控着小拨浪鼓在宁宁面前摇晃。
同时一道温和的昏睡咒打出。
让受惊的女儿重新安睡。
然后全部精力集中在妻子身上。
“看到了。”
“看到头了。”
“用力。”
“再加把劲。”
时间一分一秒过去。
每一秒都像是一个世纪那么漫长。
李长生的额头上布满了细密的汗珠。

然而有些事情，你越不想它发生，它就越会发生的。
或许这就是所谓的墨菲效应。
李长生灵识中，感到有两道陌生气息过来了。
一位炼气八层。
一位炼气九层。
而且带着浓烈的煞气和血腥味。
这两人正是刚刚赵大娘家的凶手，去而复返。
“老东西。”
“开门。”
“例行检查。”
嚣张的叫骂声，伴随着重重的砸门声，在院门外炸响。
江翠萍被突如其来的巨响，吓得浑身一僵，原本顺畅的产程瞬间停滞，气息变得紊乱起来。
“不……不要……”
江翠萍惊恐地瞪大眼睛。
“找死。”
李长生心中暴怒。
这群畜生。
你们不是走了吗？
为何去而复返？
这不是找死吗？

李长生压抑了数日的杀意，恍若火山一样爆发。
“翠萍，别管外面，看着我。”
李长生大喝一声，声音中夹杂着灵力，如洪钟大吕震住妻子的心神。
接着开口：
“专心生孩子，外面由为夫去处理。”
“可是……”
“相信我。”
江翠萍看着丈夫那从未有过的狰狞，下意识地点了点头。、、
李长生转身，走到客厅，冷冷地看着正在大门外的两位不速之客。
天堂有路，你不走。
地狱无门，你自来。
我藏了一年的底牌。
整栋房子满是杀机。
李家又岂是你们能惦记的？
李长生双手飞快结印，布置在院落四周的陷阱和阵法，无声启动了。
这是他自创的【连环爆炎符阵】。
采用大量灵符布置在特定的地方。
一旦引爆。
即便筑基修士，处于爆炸中心，都会身受重伤。
院门外两位躲在阴影中的修士一脸狞笑。

“算了。”
“看来这老东西不会开门了。”
“这房子有屏蔽阵法，肯定有问题。”
“咱们直接破门。”
其中一位用阴影蒙着脸的修士，举起手中的法器，浑身血气缭绕，一刀劈向院门。
content_en:
"Okay."
"Hold it high."
Li Changsheng smiled lovingly, held his daughter's armpits with both hands, and threw her up.
"Kekeke..."
Ningning's laughter echoed in the small courtyard.
Very innocent and lively.
Somewhat healing.
Li Changsheng caught it, threw it up again, caught it again, and so on.
The father-daughter interaction is heartwarming.
"Dad, I still want to fly..."
Ning Ning made a sweet sound, holding Li Changsheng's white beard with her little hands, smiling innocently.
"Okay."
"Daddy is a little tired."
"This is the last time."
Ning Ning nodded: "Okay. The last time. If you exhaust your father, I will feel bad."
Haha...
It seems that this little cotton-padded jacket is considerate.
It's not air leakage.
Li Changsheng smiled and raised it again, then held his daughter in his arms and rubbed his wrinkled cheek against her tender little face.
"Daddy..."
"Your beard pierced my face."
Ning Ning stretched out her hand, grabbed Li Changsheng's beard, and pulled it.
Li Changsheng felt pain for a while.
Is this girl that vindictive?
Li Changsheng complained, but didn't say anything.
This is my daughter.
At this time, Jiang Cuiping held her waist and supported her bulging belly, moved to the door, and looked at the warm scene, full of tenderness.
"You."
"Just spoil her."
"I'm almost spoiled by you."
Li Changsheng is confident and confident.
"Girl dolls are meant to be pampered."
Jiang Cuiping: "..."
What a daughter slave.
At this time, Li Changsheng's faint voice came again.
"How do you feel today? Do you feel like you're sinking?"
Jiang Cuiping shook her head and frowned slightly:
"It feels okay."
"As long as the child doesn't kick me, it doesn't hurt."
"I just feel so flustered for no reason sometimes."
"It's almost the same as when Ningning was born."
Li Changsheng smiled: "She should be giving birth soon. Pay more attention to her."
Jiang Cuiping's eyes were full of Li Changsheng: "Yeah."
Then he seemed to think of something and spoke again:
"Husband, I heard from Mrs. Zhao next door that two more families disappeared last night."
Li Changsheng helped him sit down and spoke gently:
"Don't listen to those long-tongued women talking nonsense."
"The sky cannot fall without me."
"Your mission now is to eat well, sleep well, and give birth to our second child safely."
"Don't even think about anything else."
Looking at her husband's calm eyes, Jiang Cuiping's panicked heart strangely calmed down.
My husband is very powerful.
It's like a mountain.
As long as he's here.
This home is safe.
What am I worried about?
It's quiet at night.
My wife and daughter are fast asleep.
Li Changsheng was sitting cross-legged in the center of the living room, practicing quietly, like a hibernating old turtle.
The Xuan Shuang Sword lay across his knees.
Ever since Xie Jian started the formation.
He never left his sword.
This happens every day.
This happens every night.
Seven days have passed now.
The population in the resettlement area decreased every day during these seven days.
[Demon cultivators causing chaos]?
At the foot of a fairy sect, for so long, the demon cultivator has not been caught, and there is no explanation.
They only set up a formation to trap everyone.
Is it the demonic cultivator causing trouble?
Or are you just demon cultivators?
One night.
Li Changsheng's spiritual sense saw two people whose faces were covered by shadows passing by in the alley.
The next day a female nun disappeared.
The kind that doesn't even have a body.
If Li Changsheng's guess is correct, this is not a simple act of killing people and stealing goods, but some kind of evil cultivator method.
It is similar to the tonic collection of Hehuanzong.
Use the essence, blood and soul of monks to refine magic weapons or to attack the realm.
This happened at the feet of Qingyun Sect.
Qingyun Sect......
It really sucks.
Li Changsheng sighed helplessly.
The reason why he is still stable until now is all because of his usual disguise.
Don't cause trouble.
Do not expose your cultivation.
Not tainted with cause and effect.
Not pushy.
In the eyes of Mo Xiu, Li Changsheng was a low-value target.Naturally it won't attract their attention.
But as long as this matter is not resolved.
Sooner or later the butcher's knife will fall on his head.
Li Changsheng always had a sense of urgency in his heart.
"Ah."
Suddenly a scream pierced the night sky.
The source of the sound is very close.
It should be Aunt Zhao's house next door.
Aunt Zhao's family is a very honest family.
Hearing this, Li Changsheng opened his eyes, his eyes brightened.
Immediately afterwards.
Noises could be heard, including men begging for mercy, women crying, and the muffled sound of a sharp knife piercing flesh.
The sound stopped suddenly.
Li Changsheng remained motionless.
He didn't save it.
It’s not that I don’t want to.
But can't.
In this world of evil cultivators, the trace of cheap sympathy has long been wiped away by sixty years of wind and frost.
He is survived by his wife who is about to give birth.
I have a daughter who has just turned one year old.
He couldn't afford to gamble.
As long as those people didn't break into his yard without opening their eyes.
He can pretend to be deaf.
He can also pretend to be blind.
But if anyone dares to take a step forward...
Thinking of this, Li Changsheng's eyes flashed with murderous intent, and the hand holding the sword lowered slightly.
If anyone dares to go one step further, they will fight until death.
Two black shadows passed over the wall. They did not stop in Li Changsheng's yard, but ran towards the next house.
"Unfortunately, this old woman only has a few broken spiritual stones."
"That old man doesn't have much vitality. He's as shriveled as firewood."
"Let's go to the next house. I heard that there is a young female nun in the house in front..."
The sound faded away.
Li Changsheng slowly let go of the hand holding the sword hilt, his palms already covered in cold sweat.
Even if he is already at the peak of the ninth level of Qi training.
But in this environment, facing the bottomless massacre, I still feel powerless.
Weakness is the original sin.
"Husband, what was the sound just now?"
Jiang Cuiping's trembling voice came from the bedroom.
"It's okay, let's go to bed."
Li Changsheng put away his sword and walked into the bedroom with a gentle expression. Sitting on the edge of the bed, he gently patted his wife's back, passing a trace of pure spiritual power into her body to soothe the fetal air.
"Husband, I'm afraid..."
"I thought I heard a scream..."
"That's your illusion." Li Changsheng coaxed softly.
"Well..."
Jiang Cuiping suddenly groaned, and her facial features wrinkled together in pain.
His hands subconsciously covered his towering abdomen.
"It hurts..."
"Husband, my stomach hurts..."
When Li Changsheng heard this, his expression changed slightly.
His consciousness swept away.
The amniotic water broke.
Did the second child arrive early?
Why did you give birth at this time?
There are wolves outside, and the sky is filled with blood.
The house is about to give birth, and life and death are on the line.
Is this the test of heaven for me?
"Don't be afraid."
"Live and let live."
"I'm still here."
"Follow my rhythm. Breathe...breathe...yes, that's it."
Li Changsheng forced himself to calm down.
The last time I gave birth to a baby, I could still go to Mrs. Wen.
There was no Wenpo this time.
There is no stable mother-in-law.
I am Wenpo.
Li Changsheng's eyes were firm. He had read a lot of medical books in the past year. He was already familiar with the production steps, but he had never practiced them. Fortunately, in the world of immortality, giving birth to a child is not a dangerous thing, but it does require a little suffering.
Li Changsheng quickly took out the puerperium, hot water talisman, hemostatic pill, and Qi Hui Powder that had been prepared in advance from the storage ring.
"Ah."
"It hurts."
Jiang Cuiping was sweating profusely and trembling with pain.
"Exhale."
"Breathe in."
Li Changsheng, a newbie Wenpo, drove on the road for the first time and had to cross the river by feeling the stones for his wife.
Li Changsheng is an immortal cultivator and has a natural advantage in delivering babies.
While using spiritual power to protect Jiang Cuiping.
One side guides the fetal position.
"Wow."
Ning Ning, who was sitting on the small bed next to her, was also awakened by the movement and cried loudly.
There were cries and shouts of pain in the house.
The wind was howling outside the house, and murderous intent was everywhere.
"Ning Ning, be good and don't cry."
Li Changsheng separated a ray of consciousness and controlledA small rattle was shaking in front of Ning Ning.
At the same time, a gentle sleeping spell was cast.
Putting her frightened daughter back to sleep.
Then all the energy is focused on the wife.
"I saw it."
"Seeing the end."
"Harder."
"Try harder."
Time passed by minute by minute.
Every second seems like a century.
Li Changsheng's forehead was covered with fine beads of sweat.
However, some things, the more you don't want them to happen, the more they will happen.
Maybe this is the so-called Murphy effect.
In Li Changsheng's spiritual consciousness, he felt two strange auras coming over him.
A person at the eighth level of Qi refining.
A person at the ninth level of Qi refining.
And it carries a strong smell of evil spirit and blood.
These two people were the murderers of Aunt Zhao's family just now, and they came back again.
"Old thing."
"Open the door."
"Routine inspection."
Arrogant shouts and curses, accompanied by heavy banging on the door, exploded outside the courtyard door.
Jiang Cuiping was frightened by the sudden loud noise, and her whole body froze. The originally smooth labor process suddenly stopped, and her breath became disordered.
"No...don't..."
Jiang Cuiping's eyes widened in horror.
"Seeking death."
Li Changsheng was furious.
These beasts.
Didn't you leave?
Why go and come back?
Isn't this courting death?
Li Changsheng suppressed the murderous intention for several days, and it erupted like a volcano.
"Cuiping, don't worry about the outside world and look at me."
Li Changsheng shouted loudly, his voice mixed with spiritual power, like a bell, shaking his wife's mind.
Then he spoke:
"Concentrate on having children, and let your husband handle the outside."
"But..."
"Trust me."
Jiang Cuiping looked at her husband's unprecedented ferocity and nodded subconsciously. ,,
Li Changsheng turned around, walked to the living room, and looked coldly at the two uninvited guests outside the door.
There is a road to heaven, if you don't take it.
There is no door to hell, you have to come.
A trump card I've been hiding for a year.
The whole house was full of murderous intent.
How can you care about the Li family?
Li Changsheng quickly formed seals with his hands, and the traps and formations arranged around the courtyard were activated silently.
This is his self-created [Serial Explosive Flame Talisman Array].
Use a large number of talismans to place them in specific places.
Once detonated.
Even foundation-building monks would be seriously injured if they were at the center of the explosion.
The two monks hiding in the shadows outside the courtyard gate had evil smiles on their faces.
"Forget it."
"It seems like this old guy can't open the door anymore."
"This house has a shielding formation, so there must be something wrong."
"Let's break down the door directly."
One of the monks, whose face was covered with a shadow, raised the magic weapon in his hand, his body filled with blood, and struck at the courtyard door with a knife.
